messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — ACME wants Humboldt-7B onboarded into Dedicated. We ran a FP16 baseline on their checkpoint (perf looks fine) but our GPTQ 4-bit run produced weird hallucinations on the QA suite. Posting quick logs and a short sample. Can someone triage?

Zack: Can you paste the eval prompts + one failing example? :eyes:

Maya: Sure — here's a minimal failing case:
```
PROMPT: "What is the refund policy for international orders?"
EXPECTED: "Refunds are allowed within 30 days for items returned in original condition."
OUTPUT (q4_0): "You can return it to the manufacturer in Spain. Shipping takes 2 weeks."
```

Anika: What exact quant config did you use? group_size / nf4 / residual?

Maya: Command run: 
```
python tools/quantize.py --model checkpoints/humboldt-7b --bits 4 --scheme gptq --group_size 128 --residual_fp16 False --out humboldt-7b-q4.pt
```
Ran on an A100-80GB host.

quant-bot: AUTO-REPORT: run_id=rid_2026_03_20_01 qbits=4 group_size=128 residual_fp16=False peak_gpu_mem=42GB eval_top1_exact=0.66 baseline_fp16_exact=0.87 delta_exact=-0.21 PPL_baseline=12.4 PPL_q=32.1

Ravi: Oof, PPL jump is large. First suspects: group_size too big for GPTQ, and residual_fp16 might help. Try NG-like nf4 or switching to q4_k_m / q4_1 variants if supported. Also re-run with group_size=32 or 64.

Sam: I can spin a quick smoke run with q4_k_m and group_size=32 on the dev rig. ETA ~25m.

Zack: Meanwhile can we run a small eval that measures EM / PPL on the dev prompt set (100 samples) to compare? Add a simple regression alert if exact drops >10%.

Maya: Good call. I'll kick off the EM/PPL sweep after Sam's quant artifacts are ready. Also note ACME asked for HIPAA compatibility — if q config forces residual_fp16 we need to validate memory/profile for Dedicated SLA.

Anika: Also check tokenizer alignment — sometimes tokenization shift after quant/compilation causes answer truncation. Run deterministic tokenization and diff token ids for failing prompts.

Sam: Started run: 
```
# running on dev-quant-01
quantize --model humboldt-7b --bits 4 --variant q4_k_m --group 32 --out /tmp/humboldt-q4km.pt
```
Will post artifacts. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks. If q4_k_m still fails, fallback plan: 8-bit PTQ or mixed-precision (residual_fp16) and discuss with customer tradeoffs. For prioritization — ACME is enterprise with contract in 2 weeks; recommend P1 for quant troubleshooting (affects cost SLA). Thoughts?

Ravi: Agree P1. Also log this as an onboarding blocker in the tracker and tag the infra team if we need bigger GPU for residual_fp16.

Zack: I'll add issue and label p1-humboldt-quant.

Maya: Closing loop: Sam to post artifacts and perf numbers; Anika + Ravi to review tokenization and quant config; Zack will file the issue; I'll update customer channel once we have a concrete mitigation.

quant-bot: RUN_COMPLETE: rid_2026_03_20_01 status=SUCCESS q_variant=q4_k_m group=32 eval_exact=0.82 eval_ppl=14.6 artifacts=/artifacts/rid_2026_03_20_01.zip

Sam: Posted artifacts link and brief diff. q4_k_m + group32 looks much closer to baseline. Will run a 1k-sample smoke overnight and report in the morning.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone. Reopen thread if regressions show up in the 1k run. :raised_hands:
